gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.299: Close fighting: left click throws a four-hit string, and the fourth blow sends a foe flying. Hold jump as the fourth lands to launch them, if you can fight in the air, and fight on up there with the juggle, the slam and the enemy step. A power's move or a combat art cuts a string short. Alt is a quick dash, and holding it carries you on into a long roll, out of a crowd or a blast. Hold F to block, and tap it just before a blow lands to stagger the attacker. With no fight about, left click digs as ever. Press ` (left of 1) to fight your old way, and again to come back.
